name: CNS Fujian
description: The Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy Fujian Ship (hull number: 18, referred to as Fujian Ship) is the first catapult-type aircraft carrier designed and built by China completely independently. It adopts a straight and straight flight deck, equipped with electromagnetic ejection and arresting devices, and has a full load displacement of more than 80,000 tons. It is China's third aircraft carrier.
